gates.evidence: Recorded 43-entry root checksum audit had zero mismatches; 20/20 score/state/B3 replay tracks, four query tapes, four ordered traces, four memory chains, and 20 C64 pair sets/digests matched in the prior read-only audit.

gates.evidence: 17/17 Stage 0.75-A source hashes and 11/11 native source hashes matched their recorded manifests. This establishes recorded on-disk linkage, not the exact bytes executed for the historical run.

gates.evidence: Four classes × five support seeds; four supports plus additional C64=64; group/image disjointness; Q-A-TS-v1, 3%, seed 37, 16 bins, one queried view per official sample group.

gates.name: Causal event order and shared writer
gates.evidence: Sequential event traces, tape-position equality, pre-event memory identity chains, controller-independent writer outcomes, and C64 transport transitions passed recorded comparisons. No new run was made.

gates.name: Historical B3 replay parity
gates.evidence: The stored label-free replay declares labels_supplied_to_replay=false and matches all 20 historical B3 replay tracks. This is not Stage 1 evaluation evidence.

gates.name: Original G2 executed-source closure
gates.evidence: Independent G2 certificate is package-integrity PASS with RESEARCHER_REVIEW_REQUIRED, but exact executed runner bytes are not established; original G2 remains BLOCKED. Historical query label-response digest is absent.

gates.name: Full-event B4/B7/Stage075BOffset anchors

gates.name: Causal queried-feedback linkage
gates.evidence: Event traces do not carry a separately verifiable label-response digest. The label-bearing prior measurement payload was not opened. Any future evaluation requires a private, versioned label linkage under a separate authorization.
